stages: metadata: observe loadedmetadata and finite positive duration, nonzero videoWidth/videoHeight, readyState at least2. Zero, NaN, Infinity or a clip too short to run all stages is not verified. The bounded fixture subset requires duration>=4seconds; this is a QA coverage restriction, not production rejection.

initial_playback: await actual play and timeupdate observations with no error, not paused/ended/seeking, media time advancing by at least1second and a strictly increased browser-reported frame counter. Record the counter kind; prefer webkitDecodedFrameCount, otherwise valid getVideoPlaybackQuality total/dropped counters with positive nondropped-frame advancement. Missing counters cannot pass.

middle_seek: pause, subscribe before assigning currentTime=duration/2, and observe actual seeked with seeking=false and currentTime within250ms of the requested location. This is only an asynchronous API-position tolerance, not a source-clock/media-verifier tolerance. Resume and require fresh timeupdate progression of at least1second plus frame advancement from the post-seek baseline.

eof: pause and seek to duration-min(1.5,duration/4), confirm actual seeked, resume, and observe actual ended=true. Require no error, positive post-seek time/frame progress and final currentTime within100ms of the latest finite duration. Merely paused or close-to-end is not EOF. Do not set currentTime=duration or dispatch ended manually.

replay: after that observed EOF, subscribe before assigning currentTime=0, confirm actual seeked at zero, then play. Require ended=false plus fresh actual timeupdate progression of at least1second and frame advancement; do not reload or replace the playback URL to make replay pass. This matches the existing replay operation, not its rendered button interaction.
observations: Use finite bounded numeric metadata and event counts only. Reset time/frame baselines at each intentional seek, so pre-seek progress cannot satisfy a later phase. Reject regressing time/counters inside an ordinary playback phase, unexpected source changes, nonfinite values or media error. Keep stage-specific fixed outcome enums including metadata_timeout, playback_timeout, seek_timeout, eof_timeout, replay_timeout, media_error, play_rejected, invalid_facts, unsupported_short_clip, frame_counter_unavailable and budget_exhausted; do not include arbitrary error text. bounds: At most8 completed isolated jobs, sequentially, with one video and one lease. Each file has an absolute performance.now deadline of30seconds including metadata and every phase. Check the absolute deadline after every awaited event/play promise and polling tick; each wait installs a bounded timeout and removes its listeners/timer afterward.
